name: android-remote-pdf-crash
title: Android 远程 PDF 阅读闪退调查与修复
description: 调查 Android 端阅读远程 PDF 文件时可能发生的闪退，先建立稳定复现、日志与调用链证据，再修复根因并回归远程/本地 PDF 阅读。
creator: cfl
notes: Same-device Android regression on the reporting PGFM10 device now passes for the original Baidu four-page PDF after the process-wide Pdfium gate, Reader L1 mutex lifetime fix, and WebP render-dimension cap. Non-PDF regression that exposed the transient Reader self-deadlock also passes on-device. Final product commit is 0c7e2ed874c5fddf24084a7f12ebd9e9bea2c17e. Keep task in_progress until the PRD-required local multi-page PDF smoke regression is confirmed; whole-PDF Vec<u8> buffering remains a separate architecture risk.
